I’m Amlesh Sahoo, an Electrical Engineering student in the BITS Pilani–Iowa State University dual-degree program, based in Ames, Iowa.

My work moves between circuit design, embedded programming, and the interfaces that make measurements useful. I’m interested in how the whole path fits together—from a signal on a board to data someone can understand.
